Comments:
Region Halland is definitely positive to the
development towards more person-centered care
and it has long influenced how patients are
involved, approached and how teams in
healthcare in the region work around the patient.
However, standardization risks preserving and
stagnating the development of the work and
Region Halland is thereby not in favor of the
suggestion. Region Halland does not see that
standardization in this matter would improve
quality of care.
